title: 無碴軌道底座施工~Slab-track foundation construction
focus: 底座承載溫縮排水與灌築品質~Foundation support thermal shrinkage drainage and placing quality
summary: 無碴軌道底座施工以「底座承載溫縮排水與灌築品質」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。無碴軌道底座把離散扣件作用分配到下層基礎，施工高程與長期沉陷共同決定後續可調整量；混凝土品質、排水和接縫需在同一系統內檢查。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops foundation support thermal shrinkage drainage and placing quality through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A slab-track foundation distributes discrete fastening actions to the substructure, while construction level and later settlement consume adjustment capacity; concrete quality, drainage and joints belong to one system. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把無碴軌道底座施工放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。無碴軌道底座把離散扣件作用分配到下層基礎，施工高程與長期沉陷共同決定後續可調整量；混凝土品質、排水和接縫需在同一系統內檢查。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Slab-track foundation construction in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. A slab-track foundation distributes discrete fastening actions to the substructure, while construction level and later settlement consume adjustment capacity; concrete quality, drainage and joints belong to one system. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=240 kN, A=1.2 m2；y=P/A=200 kPa。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=220 kPa。模型邊界：已知有效承壓面積且只求平均值；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：L=25 m, b=3 m, h=0.25 m；y=L*b*h=18.75 m3。只把 L 增加百分之十，y=20.625 m3。模型邊界：等斷面長方體，未扣預埋件及凹槽；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=240 kN, A=1.2 m2; y=P/A=200 kPa. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=220 kPa. Boundary: Known effective bearing area; mean pressure only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: L=25 m, b=3 m, h=0.25 m; y=L*b*h=18.75 m3. Increasing only L with a ten-percent increase gives y=20.625 m3. Boundary: Prismatic rectangular volume before deducting embedded objects and recesses; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 底座平均承壓~Foundation mean pressure
units.title: 底座平均承壓~Foundation mean pressure
units.mechanism: 合力除有效面積只給平均壓力，接觸空隙會改變實際分布。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 220 kPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。已知有效承壓面積且只求平均值。使用載重與接觸面積作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部脫空會使剩餘接觸區承壓上升，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Resultant force divided by effective area gives average pressure only; voids change its actual distribution. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 220 kPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Known effective bearing area; mean pressure only. Use load and contact area as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Local voids increase pressure over the remaining contact area; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=240 kN, A=1.2 m2；y=P/A=200 kPa。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=220 kPa。模型邊界：已知有效承壓面積且只求平均值；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=240 kN, A=1.2 m2; y=P/A=200 kPa. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=220 kPa. Boundary: Known effective bearing area; mean pressure only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以載重與接觸面積區分模型與觀察，先用模型荷重元與接觸印跡建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「底座平均承壓」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use load and contact area to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model load cell and contact imprint, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Foundation mean pressure. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 局部脫空會使剩餘接觸區承壓上升。這個失效與「底座平均承壓」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查載重與接觸面積，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Local voids increase pressure over the remaining contact area. This failure and a measurement bias in Foundation mean pressure can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check load and contact area rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部脫空會使剩餘接觸區承壓上升~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local voids increase pressure over the remaining contact area.
units.practice: 重算「底座平均承壓」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出已知有效承壓面積且只求平均值如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部脫空會使剩餘接觸區承壓上升造成偏離的合成觀察，以載重與接觸面積說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Foundation mean pressure, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Known effective bearing area; mean pressure only. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Local voids increase pressure over the remaining contact area. Explain which evidence in load and contact area distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 底座幾何方量~Foundation concrete volume
units.title: 底座幾何方量~Foundation concrete volume
units.mechanism: 幾何體積是材料帳的起點，局部凹槽與預埋空間需單獨扣除。本模型把 L 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 20.625 m3。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。等斷面長方體，未扣預埋件及凹槽。使用斷面量測與供料總量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只按供料量驗收會掩蓋外溢或空洞，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Geometric volume starts the material account, with recesses and embedded voids deducted separately. In this model, L is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 20.625 m3. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Prismatic rectangular volume before deducting embedded objects and recesses. Use section measurements and delivered volume as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Acceptance by delivery volume alone can hide leakage or voids; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：L=25 m, b=3 m, h=0.25 m；y=L*b*h=18.75 m3。只把 L 增加百分之十，y=20.625 m3。模型邊界：等斷面長方體，未扣預埋件及凹槽；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: L=25 m, b=3 m, h=0.25 m; y=L*b*h=18.75 m3. Increasing only L with a ten-percent increase gives y=20.625 m3. Boundary: Prismatic rectangular volume before deducting embedded objects and recesses; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以斷面量測與供料總量區分模型與觀察，先用長寬厚度量測與方量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「底座幾何方量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use section measurements and delivered volume to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using length, width and thickness measurements with a volume ledger, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Foundation concrete volume. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 只按供料量驗收會掩蓋外溢或空洞。這個失效與「底座幾何方量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查斷面量測與供料總量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Acceptance by delivery volume alone can hide leakage or voids. This failure and a measurement bias in Foundation concrete volume can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check section measurements and delivered volume rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只按供料量驗收會掩蓋外溢或空洞~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Acceptance by delivery volume alone can hide leakage or voids.
units.practice: 重算「底座幾何方量」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出等斷面長方體，未扣預埋件及凹槽如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只按供料量驗收會掩蓋外溢或空洞造成偏離的合成觀察，以斷面量測與供料總量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Foundation concrete volume, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Prismatic rectangular volume before deducting embedded objects and recesses. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Acceptance by delivery volume alone can hide leakage or voids. Explain which evidence in section measurements and delivered volume distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 均勻溫降收縮~Uniform cooling contraction
units.title: 均勻溫降收縮~Uniform cooling contraction
units.mechanism: 自由溫縮由熱膨脹係數、長度及溫差相乘，約束會把部分位移轉為應力。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 5.5 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻降溫且無機械約束。使用接縫位移與平均溫度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；以空氣溫度代替底座溫度會錯判收縮，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Free thermal contraction multiplies expansion coefficient, length and temperature change; restraint converts part of it into stress. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 5.5 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform cooling without mechanical restraint. Use joint movement and average temperature as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Air temperature used as slab temperature misrepresents contraction; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.00001 1/K, L=25 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=5 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=5.5 mm。模型邊界：均勻降溫且無機械約束；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.00001 1/K, L=25 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=5 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=5.5 mm. Boundary: Uniform cooling without mechanical restraint; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以接縫位移與平均溫度區分模型與觀察，先用底座內埋溫度計與端部位移建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「均勻溫降收縮」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use joint movement and average temperature to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using embedded slab thermometers and endpoint movement, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Uniform cooling contraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 以空氣溫度代替底座溫度會錯判收縮。這個失效與「均勻溫降收縮」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接縫位移與平均溫度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Air temperature used as slab temperature misrepresents contraction. This failure and a measurement bias in Uniform cooling contraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check joint movement and average temperature rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「均勻溫降收縮」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均勻降溫且無機械約束如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由以空氣溫度代替底座溫度會錯判收縮造成偏離的合成觀察，以接縫位移與平均溫度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Uniform cooling contraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform cooling without mechanical restraint. units.anchor: 約束熱應力量級~Restrained thermal stress
units.title: 約束熱應力量級~Restrained thermal stress
units.mechanism: 部分約束係數只是簡化參數，真實約束會隨開裂與徐變改變。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.98 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。常數彈模與假定約束係數，不含徐變開裂。使用溫度剖面與受限應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；假設完全約束或完全自由都可能偏離現場，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~A restraint factor is a reduced parameter; actual restraint changes with cracking and creep. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.98 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant modulus and assumed restraint factor, excluding creep and cracking. Use temperature profile and restrained strain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Assuming either complete restraint or total freedom can misrepresent the site; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=30 GPa, alpha=0.00001 1/K, dT=15 K, r=0.4 1；y=E*1000*alpha*dT*r=1.8 MPa。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=1.98 MPa。模型邊界：常數彈模與假定約束係數，不含徐變開裂；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=30 GPa, alpha=0.00001 1/K, dT=15 K, r=0.4 1; y=E*1000*alpha*dT*r=1.8 MPa. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.98 MPa. Boundary: Constant modulus and assumed restraint factor, excluding creep and cracking; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以溫度剖面與受限應變區分模型與觀察，先用溫度補償應變計與多點溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「約束熱應力量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use temperature profile and restrained strain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using temperature-compensated strain gauges and multiple temperatures, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Restrained thermal stress. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 假設完全約束或完全自由都可能偏離現場。這個失效與「約束熱應力量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查溫度剖面與受限應變，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Assuming either complete restraint or total freedom can misrepresent the site. This failure and a measurement bias in Restrained thermal stress can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check temperature profile and restrained strain rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. units.title: 試件平均強度~Specimen mean strength
units.mechanism: 三個試件平均只描述樣本，不能推定所有底座位置均達相同性能。本模型把 f1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 41.2667 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。三個等權試件平均，不是特徵強度。使用取樣位置與試件破壞型態作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；不具代表性的取樣會使漂亮平均值失去意義，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~A three-specimen mean describes that sample and does not prove identical properties everywhere in the foundation. In this model, f1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 41.2667 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Equal-weight mean of three specimens, not characteristic strength. Use sampling locations and specimen failure modes as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Unrepresentative sampling makes an attractive average uninformative; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：f1=38 MPa, f2=42 MPa, f3=40 MPa；y=(f1+f2+f3)/3=40 MPa。只把 f1 增加百分之十，y=41.2667 MPa。模型邊界：三個等權試件平均，不是特徵強度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: f1=38 MPa, f2=42 MPa, f3=40 MPa; y=(f1+f2+f3)/3=40 MPa. Increasing only f1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=41.2667 MPa. Boundary: Equal-weight mean of three specimens, not characteristic strength; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以取樣位置與試件破壞型態區分模型與觀察，先用試驗機荷重與試件尺寸建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「試件平均強度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use sampling locations and specimen failure modes to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using test-machine load and specimen dimensions, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Specimen mean strength. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

This failure and a measurement bias in Specimen mean strength can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check sampling locations and specimen failure modes rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
